# MindTab

_A simple new tab chrome extension with custom bookmarks. 🔖_

</div>

&nbsp;

## How it looks

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MindLabor/MindTab/main/images/demo.png?token=GHSAT0AAAAAABJC4H7MYSIR2SXZIKETBGK6YPCJ7ZA" width="600" />

## How to develop it
1. `npm install`
2. `npm start`

## Features
- **Custom Bookmark Groups:** Open multiple related bookmarks in a new chrome tab group with one click.
- **Search:** Currently only google support.
